label: EWSR1::ATF1
tumor_contexts: Hyalinizing clear cell carcinoma of salivary gland
Intracranial mesenchymal tumor with FET::CREB fusion

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
ATF1 encodes a CREB-family transcription factor responsive to cyclic-AMP signaling.

The fusion combines a FET-family activation region with a CREB-family DNA-binding region, producing abnormal transcriptional activation. EWSR1::ATF1 occurs in clear cell sarcoma and several distinct epithelial or mesenchymal tumors, including angiomatoid fibrous histiocytoma and salivary hyalinizing clear cell carcinoma.
